01937:     private fun getFileNameFromUri(context: Context, uri: Uri): String {
01938:         var result: String? = null
01939:         if (uri.scheme == "content") {
01940:             try {
01941:                 val cursor = context.contentResolver.query(uri, null, null, null, null)
01942:                 cursor?.use {
01943:                     if (it.moveToFirst()) {
01944:                         val index = it.getColumnIndex(OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME)
01945:                         if (index >= 0) {
01946:                             result = it.getString(index)
01947:                         }
01948:                     }
01949:                 }
01950:             } catch (e: Exception) {
01951:                 Log.e("MeshFilesUpload", "Error querying filename from uri: ${e.localizedMessage}")
01952:             }
01953:         }
01954:         if (result == null) {
01955:             result = uri.path
01956:             val cut = result?.lastIndexOf('/') ?: -1
01957:             if (cut != -1) {
01958:                 result = result?.substring(cut + 1)
01959:             }
01960:         }
01961:         return result ?: "archivo_subido"
01962:     }

01964:     private fun getFileSizeFromUri(context: Context, uri: Uri): Long {
01965:         var size = 0L
01966:         if (uri.scheme == "content") {
01967:             try {
01968:                 val cursor = context.contentResolver.query(uri, null, null, null, null)
01969:                 cursor?.use {
01970:                     if (it.moveToFirst()) {
01971:                         val index = it.getColumnIndex(OpenableColumns.SIZE)
01972:                         if (index >= 0 && !it.isNull(index)) {
01973:                             size = it.getLong(index)
01974:                         }
01975:                     }
01976:                 }
01977:             } catch (e: Exception) {
01978:                 Log.e("MeshFilesUpload", "Error querying size from uri: ${e.localizedMessage}")
01979:             }
01980:         }
01981:         if (size <= 0L) {
01982:             try {
01983:                 context.contentResolver.openFileDescriptor(uri, "r")?.use { pfd ->
01984:                     size = pfd.statSize
01985:                 }
01986:             } catch (_: Exception) {}
01987:         }
01988:         return if (size < 0L) 0L else size
01989:     }

01992:         val bytes = newContent.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
01993:         val newSize = bytes.size.toLong()
01994:
01995:         savedFileContents[filePath] = newContent
01996:         _fileContent.value = Pair(filePath, newContent)
01997:         _fileList.value = _fileList.value.map { item ->
01998:             if (item.path == filePath) {
01999:                 item.copy(size = newSize)
02000:             } else {
02001:                 item
02002:             }
02003:         }
02004:
02005:         uploadRawFileToPath(filePath, bytes)
02006:         _statusMessage.value = "Archivo guardado exitosamente"
02007:     }

02017:     fun readFileContent(item: FileItem) {
02018:         val savedText = savedFileContents[item.path]
02019:         if (savedText != null && savedText.isNotEmpty()) {
02020:             _fileContent.value = Pair(item.path, savedText)
02021:             _fileReadingProgress.value = null
02022:             return
02023:         }
02024:
02025:         val cachedContent = _fileContent.value
02026:         if (cachedContent != null && cachedContent.first == item.path && cachedContent.second.isNotEmpty()) {
02027:             _fileContent.value = Pair(item.path, cachedContent.second)
02028:             _fileReadingProgress.value = null
02029:             return
02030:         }
02031:
02032:         if (item.size == 0L && (savedText == null || savedText.isEmpty())) {
02033:             _fileContent.value = Pair(item.path, "")
02034:             _fileReadingProgress.value = null
02035:             return
02036:         }
02037:
02038:         readingFilePath = item.path
02039:         readingTotalSize = item.size
02040:         readingReceivedBytes = 0L
02041:         readingBuffer = ByteArrayOutputStream()
02042:         _fileReadingProgress.value = 0.05f
02043:
02044:         val meshId = meshClient.getNodeMeshId(cleanNodeId)
02045:         val serverUrl = meshClient.serverUrl.trimEnd('/')
02046:
02047:         val cookieToken = meshClient.userAuthCookie.ifEmpty {
02048:             meshClient.relayAuthCookie.ifEmpty {
02049:                 meshClient.extractRawToken(meshClient.authCookie)
02050:             }
02051:         }
02052:         val sessionCookie = meshClient.authCookie.trim()
02053:
02054:         scope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
02055:             try {
02056:                 val client = OkHttpHelper.createClient(meshClient.ignoreSsl)
02057:                 val encodedC = try { URLEncoder.encode(cookieToken, "UTF-8") } catch (_: Exception) { cookieToken }
02058:                 val encodedM = try { URLEncoder.encode(meshId, "UTF-8") } catch (_: Exception) { meshId }
02059:                 val encodedN = try { URLEncoder.encode(cleanNodeId, "UTF-8") } catch (_: Exception) { cleanNodeId }
02060:
02061:                 val cleanPath = item.path.removePrefix("/")
02062:                 val encodedF1 = try { URLEncoder.encode(cleanPath, "UTF-8") } catch (_: Exception) { cleanPath }
02063:                 val encodedF2 = try { URLEncoder.encode(item.path, "UTF-8") } catch (_: Exception) { item.path }
02064:
02065:                 var downloadUrl = "$serverUrl/devicefile.ashx?c=$encodedC&m=$encodedM&n=$encodedN&f=$encodedF1"
02066:                 var reqBuilder = Request.Builder().url(downloadUrl).get()
02067:                 if (sessionCookie.isNotBlank()) reqBuilder.addHeader("Cookie", sessionCookie)
02068:
02069:                 var response = client.newCall(reqBuilder.build()).execute()
02070:
02071:                 if (!response.isSuccessful) {
02072:                     downloadUrl = "$serverUrl/devicefile.ashx?c=$encodedC&m=$encodedM&n=$encodedN&f=$encodedF2"
02073:                     reqBuilder = Request.Builder().url(downloadUrl).get()
02074:                     if (sessionCookie.isNotBlank()) reqBuilder.addHeader("Cookie", sessionCookie)
02075:
02076:                     response = client.newCall(reqBuilder.build()).execute()
02077:                 }
02078:
02079:                 if (response.isSuccessful && response.body != null) {
02080:                     val bytes = response.body!!.bytes()
02081:                     val textContent = String(bytes, Charsets.UTF_8)
02082:
02083:                     if (bytes.isEmpty() && item.size > 0L && savedText != null) {
02084:                         _fileReadingProgress.value = 1.0f
02085:                         delay(150)
02086:                         readingFilePath = null
02087:                         readingBuffer = null
02088:                         _fileReadingProgress.value = null
02089:                         _fileContent.value = Pair(item.path, savedText)
02090:                         return@launch
02091:                     }
02092:
02093:                     savedFileContents[item.path] = textContent
02094:                     _fileReadingProgress.value = 1.0f
02095:                     delay(150)
02096:
02097:                     readingFilePath = null
02098:                     readingBuffer = null
02099:                     _fileReadingProgress.value = null
02100:                     _fileContent.value = Pair(item.path, textContent)
02101:                     return@launch
02102:                 }
02103:             } catch (e: Exception) {
02104:                 Log.e("MeshFilesRead", "Error in HTTP read: ${e.localizedMessage}", e)
02105:             }
02106:
02107:             // WS readfile fallback
02108:             try {
02109:                 if (!isConnected()) {
02110:                     connect()
02111:                     var waitMs = 0
02112:                     while (!_connectionState.value && waitMs < 5000) {
02113:                         delay(100)
02114:                         waitMs += 100
02115:                     }
02116:                 }
02117:
02118:                 val reqIdStr = Random.nextInt(100000, 999999).toString()
02119:                 val readReq = JsonObject().apply {
02120:                     addProperty("action", "readfile")
02121:                     addProperty("path", item.path)
02122:                     addProperty("reqid", reqIdStr)
02123:                     addProperty("id", reqIdStr)
02124:                 }
02125:                 webSocket?.send(readReq.toString())
02126:             } catch (e: Exception) {
02127:                 Log.e("MeshFilesRead", "Error in WS readfile fallback: ${e.localizedMessage}", e)
02128:                 _fileReadingProgress.value = null
02129:                 _statusMessage.value = "Error al leer archivo (${item.name})"
02130:             }
02131:         }
02132:     }

02139:     private fun remoteParent(path: String): String {
02140:         val clean = path.trimEnd('/', '\\')
02141:         require(clean.isNotEmpty()) { "No se permite operar sobre la raíz" }
02142:         require(!Regex("^[A-Za-z]:$").matches(clean)) { "No se permite operar sobre la raíz de una unidad" }
02143:
02144:         val separatorIndex = maxOf(clean.lastIndexOf('/'), clean.lastIndexOf('\\'))
02145:         require(separatorIndex >= 0) { "Se esperaba una ruta remota absoluta: $path" }
02146:
02147:         if (separatorIndex == 0) return "/"
02148:         val parent = clean.substring(0, separatorIndex)
02149:         return if (Regex("^[A-Za-z]:$").matches(parent)) "$parent/" else parent
02150:     }
02151:
02152:     private fun validateRemoteEntryName(name: String) {
02153:         require(name.isNotBlank()) { "El nombre está vacío" }
02154:         require(name != "." && name != "..") { "Nombre no permitido" }
02155:         require('/' !in name && '\\' !in name && '\u0000' !in name) { "Se esperaba un nombre, no una ruta" }
02156:     }

02158:     fun copyItem(item: FileItem) {
02159:         if (item.isDir) {
02160:             _statusMessage.value = "La función de copiar solo está disponible para archivos"
02161:             return
02162:         }
02163:         if (!_connectionState.value) {
02164:             _statusMessage.value = "No hay una sesión de archivos activa"
02165:             return
02166:         }
02167:
02168:         clipboardNodeId = cleanNodeId
02169:         _clipboardItem.value = item
02170:         _isCutMode.value = false
02171:
02172:         _statusMessage.value = "Seleccionado para copiar: ${item.name}"
02173:     }

02199:         val source = _clipboardItem.value ?: run {
02200:             _statusMessage.value = "El portapapeles está vacío"
02201:             return
02202:         }

02205:             _statusMessage.value = "Vuelve a seleccionar el elemento"
02206:             return
02207:         }
02208:
02209:         val targetNode = cleanNodeId
02210:         val destination = _currentPath.value
02211:
02212:         scope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
02213:             try {
02214:                 require(!source.isDir) { "Las operaciones de copiar y cortar solo están permitidas para archivos" }
02215:                 check(sourceNode == targetNode) { "Este portapapeles solo permite operaciones dentro del mismo equipo remoto" }
02216:
02217:                 if (!isConnected()) {
02218:                     connect()
02219:                     var waitMs = 0
02220:                     while (!_connectionState.value && waitMs < 5000) {
02221:                         delay(100)
02222:                         waitMs += 100
02223:                     }

02233:                 val reqIdStr = Random.nextInt(100000, 999999).toString()
02234:
02235:                 val cleanDest = if (destination == "/") "/" else destination.trimEnd('/')
